item.title: Difficulty focusing when upset may indicate anxiety and depression in youth
item.description: FIU psychologists find that a child's focus during emotional distress is a stronger indicator of mental health than their focus when calm.

item.title: Melatonin use linked to lower REM sleep in children
item.description: An observational study of pediatric patients suggests melatonin use may be associated with a reduced percentage of REM sleep.

item.title: Robin Roberts on breast cancer, self-advocacy, and trusting instincts
item.description: The journalist discusses how breast cancer changed her view of strength and the importance of speaking up in medical settings.
